mapper.sql: participant_id, battle_id, guild_id, user_id, guild_member_id, role_at_start, status, joined_at, left_at, snapshot_nickname, snapshot_profile_image_url, snapshot_character_id, snapshot_character_name, snapshot_character_level
mapper.select: SELECT NULL AS participant_id, NULL AS battle_id, gm.guild_id, gm.user_id, gm.guild_member_id, gm.role AS role_at_start, 'ACTIVE' AS status, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS joined_at, NULL AS left_at, u.nickname AS snapshot_nickname, u.profile_image_url AS snapshot_profile_image_url, c.character_id AS snapshot_character_id, c.name AS snapshot_character_name, c.level AS snapshot_character_level FROM guild_members gm JOIN users u ON u.user_id = gm.user_id LEFT JOIN characters c ON c.user_id = gm.user_id WHERE gm.guild_id = #{guildId} AND gm.left_at IS NULL AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY gm.joined_at ASC, gm.guild_member_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO boss_battle_participants ( battle_id, guild_id, user_id, guild_member_id, role_at_start, status, joined_at, snapshot_nickname, snapshot_profile_image_url, snapshot_character_id, snapshot_character_name, snapshot_character_level ) VALUES ( #{battleId}, #{guildId}, #{userId}, #{guildMemberId}, #{roleAtStart}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'ACTIVE'), COALESCE(#{joinedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{snapshotNickname}, #{snapshotProfileImageUrl}, #{snapshotCharacterId}, #{snapshotCharacterName}, #{snapshotCharacterLevel} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM boss_battle_participants WHERE battle_id = #{battleId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT COUNT(1) AS participant_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS active_participant_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('LEFT', 'KICKED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS left_participant_count FROM boss_battle_participants WHERE battle_id = #{battleId}
SELECT FROM boss_battle_participants WHERE battle_id = #{battleId} ORDER BY joined_at ASC, participant_id ASC
SELECT FROM boss_battle_participants WHERE battle_id = #{battleId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY joined_at ASC, participant_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE boss_battle_participants SET status = 'LEFT', left_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE guild_id = #{guildId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM boss_battles bb WHERE bb.battle_id = boss_battle_participants.battle_id AND bb.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' )

UPDATE boss_battle_participants SET status = 'KICKED', left_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE guild_id = #{guildId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM boss_battles bb WHERE bb.battle_id = boss_battle_participants.battle_id AND bb.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' )
